ayahs.textAr: الٓر ۚ تِلْكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَقُرْءَانٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
ayahs.textEn: Alif-Lãm-Ra. These are the verses of the Book; the clear Quran.

ayahs.textAr: رُّبَمَا يَوَدُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ مُسْلِمِينَ
ayahs.textEn: ˹The day will come when˺ the disbelievers will certainly wish they had submitted ˹to Allah˺.

ayahs.textAr: ذَرْهُمْ يَأْكُلُوا۟ وَيَتَمَتَّعُوا۟ وَيُلْهِهِمُ ٱلْأَمَلُ ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.textEn: ˹So˺ let them eat and enjoy themselves and be diverted by ˹false˺ hope, for they will soon know.

ayahs.textAr: وَمَآ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا وَلَهَا كِتَابٌۭ مَّعْلُومٌۭ
ayahs.textEn: We have never destroyed a society without a destined term.

ayahs.textAr: مَّا تَسْبِقُ مِنْ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسْتَـْٔخِرُونَ
ayahs.textEn: No people can advance their doom, nor can they delay it.

ayahs.textAr: وَقَالُوا۟ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِى نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلذِّكْرُ إِنَّكَ لَمَجْنُونٌۭ
ayahs.textEn: They say, “O you to whom the Reminder is revealed! You must be insane!

ayahs.textAr: لَّوْ مَا تَأْتِينَا بِٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
ayahs.textEn: Why do you not bring us the angels, if what you say is true?”

ayahs.textAr: مَا نُنَزِّلُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَمَا كَانُوٓا۟ إِذًۭا مُّنظَرِينَ
ayahs.textEn: We do not send the angels down except for a just cause, and then ˹the end of˺ the disbelievers will not be delayed.

ayahs.textAr: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا ٱلذِّكْرَ وَإِنَّا لَهُۥ لَحَٰفِظُونَ
ayahs.textEn: It is certainly We Who have revealed the Reminder, and it is certainly We Who will preserve it.

ayahs.textAr: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ فِى شِيَعِ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.textEn: Indeed, We sent messengers before you ˹O Prophet˺ among the groups of early peoples,

ayahs.textAr: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
ayahs.textEn: but no messenger ever came to them without being mocked.

ayahs.textAr: كَذَٰلِكَ نَسْلُكُهُۥ فِى قُلُوبِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
ayahs.textEn: This is how We allow disbelief ˹to steep˺ into the hearts of the wicked.

ayahs.textAr: لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ ۖ وَقَدْ خَلَتْ سُنَّةُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.textEn: They would not believe in this ˹Quran˺ despite the ˹many˺ examples of those ˹destroyed˺ before.

ayahs.textAr: وَلَوْ فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِم بَابًۭا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَظَلُّوا۟ فِيهِ يَعْرُجُونَ
ayahs.textEn: And even if We opened for them a gate to heaven, through which they continued to ascend,

ayahs.textAr: لَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَا سُكِّرَتْ أَبْصَٰرُنَا بَلْ نَحْنُ قَوْمٌۭ مَّسْحُورُونَ
ayahs.textEn: still they would say, “Our eyes have truly been dazzled! In fact, we must have been bewitched.”

ayahs.textAr: وَلَقَدْ جَعَلْنَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ بُرُوجًۭا وَزَيَّنَّٰهَا لِلنَّٰظِرِينَ
ayahs.textEn: Indeed, We have placed constellations in the sky, and adorned it for all to see.

ayahs.textAr: وَحَفِظْنَٰهَا مِن كُلِّ شَيْطَٰنٍۢ رَّجِيمٍ
ayahs.textEn: And We protected it from every accursed devil,

ayahs.textAr: إِلَّا مَنِ ٱسْتَرَقَ ٱلسَّمْعَ فَأَتْبَعَهُۥ شِهَابٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
ayahs.textEn: except the one eavesdropping, who is then pursued by a visible flare.

ayahs.textAr: وَٱلْأَرْضَ مَدَدْنَٰهَا وَأَلْقَيْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ وَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ مَّوْزُونٍۢ
ayahs.textEn: As for the earth, We spread it out and placed upon it firm mountains, and caused everything to grow there in perfect balance.

ayahs.textAr: وَجَعَلْنَا لَكُمْ فِيهَا مَعَٰيِشَ وَمَن لَّسْتُمْ لَهُۥ بِرَٰزِقِينَ
ayahs.textEn: And We made in it means of sustenance for you and others, who you do not provide for.

ayahs.textAr: وَإِن مِّن شَىْءٍ إِلَّا عِندَنَا خَزَآئِنُهُۥ وَمَا نُنَزِّلُهُۥٓ إِلَّا بِقَدَرٍۢ مَّعْلُومٍۢ
ayahs.textEn: There is not any means ˹of sustenance˺ whose reserves We do not hold, only bringing it forth in precise measure.

ayahs.textAr: وَأَرْسَلْنَا ٱلرِّيَٰحَ لَوَٰقِحَ فَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ فَأَسْقَيْنَٰكُمُوهُ وَمَآ أَنتُمْ لَهُۥ بِخَٰزِنِينَ
ayahs.textEn: We send fertilizing winds, and bring down rain from the sky for you to drink. It is not you who hold its reserves.

ayahs.textAr: وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ نُحْىِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَنَحْنُ ٱلْوَٰرِثُونَ
ayahs.textEn: Surely it is We Who give life and cause death. And We are the ˹Eternal˺ Successor.

ayahs.textAr: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا ٱلْمُسْتَقْدِمِينَ مِنكُمْ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا ٱلْمُسْتَـْٔخِرِينَ
ayahs.textEn: We certainly know those who have gone before you and those who will come after ˹you˺.

ayahs.textAr: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ حَكِيمٌ عَلِيمٌۭ
ayahs.textEn: Surely your Lord ˹alone˺ will gather them together ˹for judgment˺. He is truly All-Wise, All-Knowing.

ayahs.textAr: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِن صَلْصَٰلٍۢ مِّنْ حَمَإٍۢ مَّسْنُونٍۢ
ayahs.textEn: Indeed, We created man from sounding clay moulded from black mud.

ayahs.textAr: وَٱلْجَآنَّ خَلَقْنَٰهُ مِن قَبْلُ مِن نَّارِ ٱلسَّمُومِ
ayahs.textEn: As for the jinn, We created them earlier from smokeless fire.

ayahs.textAr: وَإِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّى خَٰلِقٌۢ بَشَرًۭا مِّن صَلْصَٰلٍۢ مِّنْ حَمَإٍۢ مَّسْنُونٍۢ
ayahs.textEn: ˹Remember, O  Prophet˺ when your Lord said to the angels, “I am going to create a human being from sounding clay moulded from black mud.

ayahs.textAr: فَإِذَا سَوَّيْتُهُۥ وَنَفَخْتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِى فَقَعُوا۟ لَهُۥ سَٰجِدِينَ
ayahs.textEn: So when I have fashioned him and had a spirit of My Own ˹creation˺ breathed into him, fall down in prostration to him.”

ayahs.textAr: فَسَجَدَ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ أَجْمَعُونَ
ayahs.textEn: So the angels prostrated all together—

ayahs.textAr: إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ أَبَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونَ مَعَ ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ
ayahs.textEn: but not Iblis, who refused to prostrate with the others.

ayahs.textAr: قَالَ يَٰٓإِبْلِيسُ مَا لَكَ أَلَّا تَكُونَ مَعَ ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ
ayahs.textEn: Allah asked, “O Iblis! What is the matter with you that you did not join others in prostration?”

ayahs.textAr: قَالَ لَمْ أَكُن لِّأَسْجُدَ لِبَشَرٍ خَلَقْتَهُۥ مِن صَلْصَٰلٍۢ مِّنْ حَمَإٍۢ مَّسْنُونٍۢ
ayahs.textEn: He replied, “It is not for me to prostrate to a human You created from sounding clay moulded from black mud.”

ayahs.textAr: قَالَ فَٱخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٌۭ
ayahs.textEn: Allah commanded, “Then get out of Paradise, for you are truly cursed.

ayahs.textAr: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكَ ٱللَّعْنَةَ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
ayahs.textEn: And surely upon you is condemnation until the Day of Judgment.”

ayahs.textAr: قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرْنِىٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
ayahs.textEn: Satan appealed, “My Lord! Then delay my end until the Day of their resurrection.”

ayahs.textAr: قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنظَرِينَ
ayahs.textEn: Allah said, “You will be delayed

ayahs.textAr: إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْوَقْتِ ٱلْمَعْلُومِ
ayahs.textEn: until the appointed Day.”

ayahs.textAr: قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَآ أَغْوَيْتَنِى لَأُزَيِّنَنَّ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
ayahs.textEn: Satan responded, “My Lord! For allowing me to stray I will surely tempt them on earth and mislead them all together,

ayahs.textAr: إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
ayahs.textEn: except Your chosen servants among them.”

ayahs.textAr: قَالَ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ عَلَىَّ مُسْتَقِيمٌ
ayahs.textEn: Allah said, “This is the Way, binding on Me:

ayahs.textAr: إِنَّ عِبَادِى لَيْسَ لَكَ عَلَيْهِمْ سُلْطَٰنٌ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلْغَاوِينَ
ayahs.textEn: you will certainly have no authority over My servants, except the deviant who follow you,

ayahs.textAr: وَإِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمَوْعِدُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
ayahs.textEn: and surely Hell is their destined place, all together.

ayahs.textAr: لَهَا سَبْعَةُ أَبْوَٰبٍۢ لِّكُلِّ بَابٍۢ مِّنْهُمْ جُزْءٌۭ مَّقْسُومٌ
ayahs.textEn: It has seven gates, to each a group of them is designated.”

ayahs.textAr: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَعُيُونٍ
ayahs.textEn: Indeed, the righteous will be amid Gardens and springs.

ayahs.textAr: ٱدْخُلُوهَا بِسَلَٰمٍ ءَامِنِينَ
ayahs.textEn: ˹It will be said to them,˺ “Enter in peace and security.”

ayahs.textAr: وَنَزَعْنَا مَا فِى صُدُورِهِم مِّنْ غِلٍّ إِخْوَٰنًا عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍۢ مُّتَقَٰبِلِينَ
ayahs.textEn: We will remove whatever bitterness they had in their hearts. In a friendly manner, they will be on thrones, facing one another.

ayahs.textAr: لَا يَمَسُّهُمْ فِيهَا نَصَبٌۭ وَمَا هُم مِّنْهَا بِمُخْرَجِينَ
ayahs.textEn: No fatigue will touch them there, nor will they ever be asked to leave.

ayahs.textAr: ۞ نَبِّئْ عِبَادِىٓ أَنِّىٓ أَنَا ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
ayahs.textEn: Inform My servants ˹O Prophet˺ that I am truly the All-Forgiving, Most Merciful,

ayahs.textAr: وَأَنَّ عَذَابِى هُوَ ٱلْعَذَابُ ٱلْأَلِيمُ
ayahs.textEn: and that My torment is indeed the most painful.

ayahs.textAr: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ عَن ضَيْفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ
ayahs.textEn: And inform them ˹O Prophet˺ about Abraham’s guests

ayahs.textAr: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوا۟ سَلَٰمًۭا قَالَ إِنَّا مِنكُمْ وَجِلُونَ
ayahs.textEn: who entered upon him and greeted ˹him with˺, “Peace!” He ˹later˺ said, “Surely we are afraid of you.”

ayahs.textAr: قَالُوا۟ لَا تَوْجَلْ إِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلَٰمٍ عَلِيمٍۢ
ayahs.textEn: They reassured ˹him˺, “Do not be afraid! Surely we give you good news of a knowledgeable son.”

ayahs.textAr: قَالَ أَبَشَّرْتُمُونِى عَلَىٰٓ أَن مَّسَّنِىَ ٱلْكِبَرُ فَبِمَ تُبَشِّرُونَ
ayahs.textEn: He wondered, “Do you give me good news despite my old age? What unlikely news!”

ayahs.textAr: قَالُوا۟ بَشَّرْنَٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ فَلَا تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْقَٰنِطِينَ
ayahs.textEn: They responded, “We give you good news in all truth, so do not be one of those who despair.”

ayahs.textAr: قَالَ وَمَن يَقْنَطُ مِن رَّحْمَةِ رَبِّهِۦٓ إِلَّا ٱلضَّآلُّونَ
ayahs.textEn: He exclaimed, “Who would despair of the mercy of their Lord except the misguided?”

ayahs.textAr: قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
ayahs.textEn: He ˹then˺ added, “What is your mission, O  messenger-angels?”

ayahs.textAr: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ أُرْسِلْنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍۢ مُّجْرِمِينَ
ayahs.textEn: They replied, “We have actually been sent to a wicked people.

ayahs.textAr: إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍ إِنَّا لَمُنَجُّوهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
ayahs.textEn: As for the family of Lot, we will certainly deliver them all,

ayahs.textAr: إِلَّا ٱمْرَأَتَهُۥ قَدَّرْنَآ ۙ إِنَّهَا لَمِنَ ٱلْغَٰبِرِينَ
ayahs.textEn: except his wife. We have determined that she will be one of the doomed.”

ayahs.textAr: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ءَالَ لُوطٍ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
ayahs.textEn: So when the messengers came to the family of Lot,

ayahs.textAr: قَالَ إِنَّكُمْ قَوْمٌۭ مُّنكَرُونَ
ayahs.textEn: he said, “You are surely an unfamiliar people!”

ayahs.textAr: قَالُوا۟ بَلْ جِئْنَٰكَ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ فِيهِ يَمْتَرُونَ
ayahs.textEn: They responded, “We have come to you with that ˹torment˺ which they have doubted.

ayahs.textAr: وَأَتَيْنَٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَإِنَّا لَصَٰدِقُونَ
ayahs.textEn: We come to you with the truth, and we are certainly truthful.

ayahs.textAr: فَأَسْرِ بِأَهْلِكَ بِقِطْعٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱتَّبِعْ أَدْبَٰرَهُمْ وَلَا يَلْتَفِتْ مِنكُمْ أَحَدٌۭ وَٱمْضُوا۟ حَيْثُ تُؤْمَرُونَ
ayahs.textEn: So travel with your family in the dark of night, and follow ˹closely˺ behind them. Do not let any of you look back, and go where you are commanded.”

ayahs.textAr: وَقَضَيْنَآ إِلَيْهِ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْأَمْرَ أَنَّ دَابِرَ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ مَقْطُوعٌۭ مُّصْبِحِينَ
ayahs.textEn: We revealed to him this decree: “Those ˹sinners˺ will be uprooted in the morning.”

ayahs.textAr: وَجَآءَ أَهْلُ ٱلْمَدِينَةِ يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ
ayahs.textEn: And there came the men of the city, rejoicing.

ayahs.textAr: قَالَ إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ ضَيْفِى فَلَا تَفْضَحُونِ
ayahs.textEn: Lot pleaded, “Indeed, these are my guests, so do not embarrass me.

ayahs.textAr: وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَلَا تُخْزُونِ
ayahs.textEn: Fear Allah and do not humiliate me.”

ayahs.textAr: قَالُوٓا۟ أَوَلَمْ نَنْهَكَ عَنِ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.textEn: They responded, “Have we not forbidden you from protecting anyone?”

ayahs.textAr: قَالَ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ بَنَاتِىٓ إِن كُنتُمْ فَٰعِلِينَ
ayahs.textEn: He said, “O my people! Here are my daughters ˹so marry them˺ if you wish to do so.”

ayahs.textAr: لَعَمْرُكَ إِنَّهُمْ لَفِى سَكْرَتِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ
ayahs.textEn: By your life ˹O Prophet˺, they certainly wandered blindly, intoxicated ˹by lust˺.

ayahs.textAr: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ مُشْرِقِينَ
ayahs.textEn: So the ˹mighty˺ blast overtook them at sunrise.

ayahs.textAr: فَجَعَلْنَا عَٰلِيَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةًۭ مِّن سِجِّيلٍ
ayahs.textEn: And We turned the cities ˹of Sodom and Gomorrah˺ upside down and rained upon them stones of baked clay.

ayahs.textAr: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ لِّلْمُتَوَسِّمِينَ
ayahs.textEn: Surely in this are signs for those who contemplate.

ayahs.textAr: وَإِنَّهَا لَبِسَبِيلٍۢ مُّقِيمٍ
ayahs.textEn: Their ruins still lie along a known route.

ayahs.textAr: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.textEn: Surely in this is a sign for those who believe.

ayahs.textAr: وَإِن كَانَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْأَيْكَةِ لَظَٰلِمِينَ
ayahs.textEn: And the residents of the Forest were truly wrongdoers,

ayahs.textAr: فَٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ وَإِنَّهُمَا لَبِإِمَامٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
ayahs.textEn: so We inflicted punishment upon them. The ruins of both nations still lie on a well-known road.

ayahs.textAr: وَلَقَدْ كَذَّبَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْحِجْرِ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
ayahs.textEn: Indeed, the residents of the Stone Valley also denied the messengers.

ayahs.textAr: وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُمْ ءَايَٰتِنَا فَكَانُوا۟ عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ
ayahs.textEn: We gave them Our signs, but they turned away from them.

ayahs.textAr: وَكَانُوا۟ يَنْحِتُونَ مِنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا ءَامِنِينَ
ayahs.textEn: They carved their homes in the mountains, feeling secure.

ayahs.textAr: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ مُصْبِحِينَ
ayahs.textEn: But the ˹mighty˺ blast overtook them in the morning,

ayahs.textAr: فَمَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
ayahs.textEn: and all they achieved was of no help to them.

ayahs.textAr: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ ۗ وَإِنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ لَءَاتِيَةٌۭ ۖ فَٱصْفَحِ ٱلصَّفْحَ ٱلْجَمِيلَ
ayahs.textEn: We have not created the heavens and the earth and everything in between except for a purpose. And the Hour is certain to come, so forgive graciously.

ayahs.textAr: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ ٱلْخَلَّٰقُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
ayahs.textEn: Surely your Lord is the Master Creator, All-Knowing.

ayahs.textAr: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَٰكَ سَبْعًۭا مِّنَ ٱلْمَثَانِى وَٱلْقُرْءَانَ ٱلْعَظِيمَ
ayahs.textEn: We have certainly granted you the seven often-repeated verses and the great Quran.

ayahs.textAr: لَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَيْنَيْكَ إِلَىٰ مَا مَتَّعْنَا بِهِۦٓ أَزْوَٰجًۭا مِّنْهُمْ وَلَا تَحْزَنْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَٱخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.textEn: Do not let your eyes crave the ˹fleeting˺ pleasures We have provided for some of the disbelievers, nor grieve for them. And be gracious to the believers.

ayahs.textAr: وَقُلْ إِنِّىٓ أَنَا ٱلنَّذِيرُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
ayahs.textEn: And say, “I am truly sent with a clear warning”—

ayahs.textAr: كَمَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَى ٱلْمُقْتَسِمِينَ
ayahs.textEn: ˹a warning˺ similar to what We sent to those who divided ˹the Scriptures˺,

ayahs.textAr: ٱلَّذِينَ جَعَلُوا۟ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ عِضِينَ
ayahs.textEn: who ˹now˺ accept parts of the Quran, rejecting others.

ayahs.textAr: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَسْـَٔلَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
ayahs.textEn: So by your Lord! We will certainly question them all

ayahs.textAr: عَمَّا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
ayahs.textEn: about what they used to do.

ayahs.textAr: فَٱصْدَعْ بِمَا تُؤْمَرُ وَأَعْرِضْ عَنِ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
ayahs.textEn: So proclaim what you have been commanded, and turn away from the polytheists.

ayahs.textAr: إِنَّا كَفَيْنَٰكَ ٱلْمُسْتَهْزِءِينَ
ayahs.textEn: Surely We will be sufficient for you against the mockers,

ayahs.textAr: ٱلَّذِينَ يَجْعَلُونَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ ۚ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.textEn: who set up ˹other˺ gods with Allah. They will soon come to know.

ayahs.textAr: وَلَقَدْ نَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ يَضِيقُ صَدْرُكَ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ
ayahs.textEn: We certainly know that your heart is truly distressed by what they say.

ayahs.textAr: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَكُن مِّنَ ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ
ayahs.textEn: So glorify the praises of your Lord and be one of those who ˹always˺ pray,

ayahs.textAr: وَٱعْبُدْ رَبَّكَ حَتَّىٰ يَأْتِيَكَ ٱلْيَقِينُ
ayahs.textEn: and worship your Lord until the inevitable comes your way.
